description: AI news digest Sep 23: Opus 5.5 and GPT-6 Sol/Luna launch same day with price cuts, Snorkel $350M, ClosedQuorum malware, Isaac ROS 5.0.
lead: Two flagship launches hours apart, and both led with price instead of capability. Anthropic shipped Claude Opus 5.5 with lower list prices and faster output, OpenAI answered with GPT-6 Sol and Luna at half their predecessors' rates, Snorkel raised $350M to sell the training data underneath it all, researchers documented malware that lets four models vote on its next move, and NVIDIA brought agentic workflows to open-source robotics. Every summary is in our own words; follow the links for the original reporting.
title: AI news digest — September 23, 2026: dual flagship launches, cheaper models, autonomous malware
